subject.title: feat(workboard): review gate hard blocks + workboard_submit_review tool

question: Should Workboard add a durable `ready_to_merge` status and fail-closed completion gate in this PR, or should review approval stay modeled with existing statuses and proof metadata?
rationale: The PR changes the persisted card lifecycle and can stop existing Workboard completion flows at runtime, so implementation repair alone cannot decide the intended product contract.

options.title: Repair and keep the review lifecycle
options.body: Keep the new lifecycle direction, but require the PR to preserve existing contracts, update metadata/UI/tests, and include upgrade plus real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Use existing statuses only
options.body: Reject `ready_to_merge` as persisted state for now and model review approval through existing `review` plus proof metadata.

options.title: Pause for a narrower design
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers define the exact review-gate state machine and tool contract outside the contributor branch.

recommendation.title: Repair and keep the review lifecycle
recommendation.body: Keep the new lifecycle direction, but require the PR to preserve existing contracts, update metadata/UI/tests, and include upgrade plus real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the Workboard coordination tool surface and plugin metadata being extended here.
